title: Implementation Outcomes and Local Conversion, 2025-2026
summary: Sixteen reviewed official records showing where federal programs and local projects have moved into obligations, governance changes, physical construction, software, standards drafts, procurement channels, regulatory action, or dated conversion gates.
scope: The collection follows selected Phase 55L trails and the two FTFN local dossiers. It records the strongest implementation stage supported by each source, including discontinuities and oversight limits, while preserving the next financial, physical, technical, regulatory, acceptance, operating, and scale gates.
download_note: The 19-file archive contains ten official local captures, six official-link records for blocked or interactive hosts, consolidated summaries, a README, and a SHA-256 manifest.
method_note: A record qualifies only when it names a project, recipient, operator, facility, agreement, physical milestone, software release, standards artifact, procurement channel, regulatory action, or dated decision gate. Announced value, obligation, outlay, award, construction, test, acceptance, operation, and scale remain separate stages. Official claims are attributed, later reversals are preserved, and absence of a downstream record is not converted into a negative outcome.
